title: Refrigerator timeline
kind: 时间线说明文 · 从古代冰藏到节能冰箱的发展

timeline.text: Ancient times: Ancient China, Greece, and Rome used ice or snow to preserve food by freezing or chilling it.
1600s: Icehouses were used to preserve food all year-round.
1748: William Cullen did an experiment on artificial refrigeration.
1805: Oliver Evans designed the first refrigeration machine.
1890s: Iceboxes became popular. They were smaller icehouses meant for home use.
1913: Fred W. Wolf invented the first home electric refrigerator.
1918: Mass production of home refrigerators began.
1920s: Refrigerators became popular in some countries.
